question: Air India’s journey begins in the year ________, when the distinguished entrepreneur J.R.D. Tata founded the company.​
solution:
The correct answer is __"____**1932**"__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On this date (***15 October 1932***), exactly 90 years ago, India's first commercial airmail trip departed from Karachi and arrived in Mumbai.
 
• ***JRD Tata*** piloted the first flight, which served as Air India's debut.
 
• Air India’s journey begins in the year ***1932***, when the distinguished entrepreneur J.R.D. Tata founded the company.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first commercial flight in India, which took out from*** Karachi to Mumbai ***on October 15, 1932, was piloted by Air India's previous chairman JRD Tata on that day. 
 
• ***JRD Tata***, an avid pilot who served as the longest-serving chairman of the Tata group, is credited with founding civil aviation in India. 
 
• On October 15, 1932, he flew the first ***de Havilland Puss Moth***, a single-engine aircraft, for the then-Tata Air Services from Karachi to Bombay via Ahmedabad, laying the foundation for Indian civil aviation.
